events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! The voice of a generation, still bringing that swagger and those anthems. What's your top track from the main man?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album released 55 years ago
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic solo album 'Imagine' was released in the UK on October 8, 1971, featuring the timeless title track.

angles.name: Timeless Anthem
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon gave us 'Imagine', an anthem that still resonates globally. A powerful message, beautifully delivered. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: Apple unveiled the first iPod 25 years ago
events.blurb: Apple first announced the revolutionary iPod, promising '1,000 songs in your pocket', on October 23, 2001.

angles.name: Pocket Full of Tunes
angles.copy: Remember the first time you saw an iPod? Twenty-five years ago, Apple unveiled the device that changed how we listen to music forever. A true game-changer.

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! Time to celebrate the iconic spy with your favourite theme tune. What's the ultimate Bond song for you? Licence to thrill!

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles co-founder and peace activist John Lennon was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Remembering a Visionary
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the incredible life and enduring legacy of John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From silly walks to 'Fawlty Towers', his comedic genius is truly unmatched. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released 58 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but widely known as the 'White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: Iconic Double Album
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unveiled their ambitious 'White Album'. A sprawling, diverse masterpiece that broke new ground. What's your standout track from this classic?

events.title: 35 years since Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the incomparable Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, passed away on November 24, 1991.

angles.name: Remembering a Legend
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago, we lost the extraordinary Freddie Mercury. His voice, showmanship, and legacy continue to shine. Forever a champion.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released 61 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', was released on December 3, 1965, marking a pivotal moment in their artistic evolution.

angles.name: Revolutionary Sound
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul', an album that truly pushed the boundaries of pop music. What's your favourite track from this innovative record?

events.title: 46 years since John Lennon's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic passing of John Lennon on December 8, 1980, in New York City.

angles.name: His Legacy Lives On
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, the world lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to resonate globally. Remembering a true icon.
